name: Woman's Jacket with Decoration of a Dragon and Crane and Clouds above Rocks and Waves
dimensions: H. 70.5 x W. (across sleeves) 152.4 cm (27 3/4 x 60 in.)
summary: This waist-length jacket has straight sides with a short vent on either side; a high neck with a short, standing collar; and wrist-length sleeves of even width from shoulder to wrist.  The jacket opens down the front and is secured by three spherical brass buttons that fit through corresponding loops.
